## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

- [ ] Lint, type checks, and unit tests with at least 95% coverage pass.
- [ ] Bug fixes include a regression test that failed before the fix.
- [ ] New/changed tools have MCP-layer integration scenarios; live results and limits are described below.
- [ ] Pagination/aggregation covers multiple pages, and each public parameter has its documented effect.
- [ ] Module docs and bilingual content are updated where relevant.
- [ ] The catalog generator was run and its output committed where relevant.

List commands run, outcomes, live endpoints checked, and anything left unverified.
Mark non-applicable items as N/A with a brief explanation.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ReyemTech/mcp-canada/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for commands and examples.
